g.text: ET-native chip — fabricated by Mike from raw silicon

svg.text: Digital (P∘D): exact integers, tensor ROM, GCD classification, memo, bus
Analog (D): continuous ε, projection/pullback, codec (IC-127), complex refs ③-⑦
Quantum (T): diamond ① + nitrogen ②, NV qubits, T-acts, κ-correction
All three domains connected by bijection Π_N with ZERO loss. Universal free codec (IC-127).
7 materials cover all 12 families: ① diamond (6 simple) + ② N (d=5) + ③④⑤⑥⑦ (d=7-11).
